races.name: racingtv.com/freetrial 'Chasing Excellence' Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
EMID'IO PEPE finished ahead of Act Of Authority when they met at Aintree in April, and Dan Skelton's unexposed 5-y-o is taken to confirm that form on chasing debut.

  1. EMID'IO PEPE (FR)
  2. ACT OF AUTHORITY (FR)

races.name: Stratford Extra Raceday 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
EASTERN FIRE looks the clear pick of the Dan Skelton-trained quartet here and gets a confident vote to make amends for his last-flight fall at Perth (upsides winner) on his recent hurdling bow and add to his earlier bumper success. Stablemate Blackswan d'Oroux could emerge as the one to chase him home ahead of fellow hurdling debutant Oykel Bridge and the returning Wallquatari.

  1. EASTERN FIRE (IRE)
  2. BLACKSWAN D'OROUX (FR)
  3. OYKEL BRIDGE (IRE)

races.name: Jumps Look Better On Racing TV Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MAJOR FORTUNE was a double winner over fences last season and can build on a promising Perth reappearance third to add to his tally here. Lord Of Cheshire has a long absence to overcome but remains with potential and could still have a say with his yard going well, while Sunshine Diamond should strip sharper for a recent Worcester second and play a part.

  1. MAJOR FORTUNE (IRE)
  2. LORD OF CHESHIRE (FR)
  3. SUNSHINE DIAMOND (IRE)

races.name: Trailertrek Towbars Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
LUNE BRILLANTE showed a good turn of foot when going in at the first time of asking over hurdles at Worcester recently and can follow up over this longer trip to thwart Locker Boum who also made a winning start in this sphere at Chepstow and should ensure Dan Skelton's mare doesn't have things all her own way. Padre Arthur also has the form to play a part if back on song on his return.

  1. LUNE BRILLANTE (IRE)
  2. LOCKER BOUM (FR)
  3. PADRE ARTHUR

races.name: Get A Free Trial Of Racing TV Now Mares' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
None of these can be ruled out but it could be worth siding with Dan Skelton's SERVICE MINIMUM who has returned better than ever over hurdles and now has her first go over fences. She Is For Me Boys rates just the pick of the weights of those with chasing experience and is next on the list.

  1. SERVICE MINIMUM (FR)
  2. SHE IS FOR ME BOYS
  3. BEST WOMEN (IRE)

races.name: 31 Days Free Racing TV At racingtv.com/freetrial Novices' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
RED RUBIO has form that reads well in this company. He gets the nod over Molly's Lad, who could improve up in trip on handicap bow. Drumlee Orders and Lord Virginia also need considering in an open-looking event.

  1. RED RUBIO (IRE)
  2. MOLLY'S LAD
  3. DRUMLEE ORDERS (IRE)

races.name: Annual Membership For Christmas Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Only 2 of these have chasing experience and the accurate jumping of COUNT ADHEMAR could prove a real asset so he is taken to make light of a 5 lb rise for his ready success at Haydock in the spring. Apollon Forlonge enjoyed a good first season over hurdles and could emerge as the pick of the chasing newcomers.

  1. COUNT ADHEMAR (IRE)
  2. APOLLON FORLONGE (FR)
  3. CAN'T RESIST IT

races.name: Racing TV Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
POETS WHISPER picked up in striking fashion once the penny dropped to win a Kelso bumper in the spring and is taken to follow up now hurdling. Noel Kelly's new recruit Tyson Fury has placed several times in similar races already this season and should figure again. Teeshan hasn't been seen since finishing down the field in the Champion Bumper at the 2024 Cheltenham Festival but would still very much enter the reckoning should the betting vibes be strong on this return for Dan Skelton.

  1. POETS WHISPER (IRE)
  2. TYSON FURY
  3. TEESHAN (IRE)

races.name: Unibet Middle Distance Chase Series Veterans' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
HELLO JUDGE can build on his promising C&D reappearance and land Carlisle win number 7. Parisencore looks the obvious danger.

  1. HELLO JUDGE
  2. PARISENCORE (FR)
  3. DUBAI DAYS (IRE)

races.name: Fatty Renshaw Memorial Novices' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
In a race where few arrive with compelling claims MATCHING ENERGY is taken to build on his encouraging Perth reappearance and prove too strong for recent Fontwell scorer Diamond White. John Dawson handicap newcomer Whin Cover is next on the list.

  1. MATCHING ENERGY
  2. DIAMOND WHITE (IRE)
  3. WHIN COVER

races.name: Weatherbys nhstallions.co.uk Graduation Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BE AWARE attained a smart level over fences last season and is very much the percentage call, although he faces an interesting opponent in Cristal d'Estruval who won a point before bolting up 2 in hurdles at the end of last year.

  1. BE AWARE (FR)
  2. CRISTAL D'ESTRUVAL (IRE)
  3. ALL THE GLORY

races.name: Christmas Community Raceday 13th December Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
GAELIC GLOW hails from an in-form yard and may well get off the mark on just his third handicap start. Interesting stable-switcher Madame La Papillon and course bumper winner Nobotheratall head the dangers, along with Circuit Breaker, while Mr Caulfield and Heritier are worth noting for support.

  1. GAELIC GLOW
  2. MADAME LA PAPILLON
  3. NOBOTHERATALL (IRE)

races.name: Great Gable Mares' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
OH CLARE shaped well over hurdles last season, including here, and might prove the answer switched to fences for her handicap debut/reappearance. Redeeming Love should have a chase win in her this winter and is second choice ahead of Oh Janey.

  1. OH CLARE (IRE)
  2. REDEEMING LOVE (IRE)
  3. OH JANEY (IRE)

races.name: Book Your Christmas Party Here Mares' Open Maiden NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The betting will be informative. Irish point winner LADY JETFIRE gets the vote to make a successful start to her Rules career for Jamie Snowden. Belle Noire, whose stable has a very healthy bumper strike rate, Olly Murphy's Who's That Lady and ready point winner Lutece Borget are other interesting contenders.

  1. LADY JETFIRE (IRE)
  2. BELLE NOIRE (IRE)
  3. WHO'S THAT LADY (IRE)

races.name: Matchbook Betting Exchange Handicap Chase (0-100)
races.verdict:
WESTERN MODEL's latest Sligo third came in a race which has worked out really well and he's taken to open his chase account now. Il Silenzio has a solid chase record and is second choice ahead of recent Sligo hurdle winner Moorish Castle, who appeals as one likely to take to fences.

  1. WESTERN MODEL (IRE)
  2. IL SILENZIO
  3. MOORISH CASTLE (IRE)

races.name: Matchbook Betting Exchange Rated Novice Chase
races.verdict:
RATTLEDELATCH opened his chasing account in good style at Tramore last time and can add to it here at the likely chief expense of fencing newcomers Torpille Dagrostis and Good Option who are both in very good hands and bring potential. Butter Fingers completes the shortlist now back at a more suitable trip.

  1. RATTLEDELATCH (IRE)
  2. TORPILLE DAGROSTIS (FR)
  3. GOOD OPTION (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Academy Hurdle
races.verdict:
This may go the way of a newcomer from a top yard, with GLENAGEARY narrowly preferred to stablemate Smokin Aces. Silk's Legacy also needs a close look, while Destinedforhistory is easily the pick of those with experience.

  1. GLENAGEARY (IRE)
  2. SMOKIN ACES (FR)
  3. SILK'S LEGACY (IRE)

races.name: Matchbook 50/50 Series 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
BORORA AURA signed off on the Flat with a breakthrough victory at Bellewstown for Michael Mulvany and also shaped well on her hurdling debut for her new stable when third at Galway so gets the vote here. Both Blissful Bonita (second choice) and Coexist are in excellent hands and bring fair form from the Flat too so could emerge as the main dangers.

  1. BORORA AURA (IRE)
  2. BLISSFUL BONITA (IRE)
  3. COEXIST (IRE)

races.name: Matchbook 50/50 Series Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
IT'S ONLY A GAME and Werner are both very interesting hurdling debutants, with Martin Brassil's course bumper winner narrowly shading the vote. Leonard Vallis could also go well second time up over hurdles.

  1. IT'S ONLY A GAME (FR)
  2. WERNER (GER)
  3. LEONARD VALLIS (FR)

races.name: Matchbook Betting Exchange Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Handicap debutant SEA EAGLE gets the nod in a tricky event. Hamsiyann often comes good at this time of year, and he's feared most on return, while Belle The Tigress could have a say if ready to roll on the back of an absence.

  1. SEA EAGLE
  2. HAMSIYANN (IRE)
  3. BELLE THE TIGRESS (IRE)

races.name: Matchbook 50/50 Series Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
BRICKFIELD BELLE ticks plenty of boxes and can open her hurdles account at the third attempt. Viva Laa Vida could make it a 1-2 for the yard, with debutant Rock On Suzie also considered.

  1. BRICKFIELD BELLE (IRE)
  2. VIVA LAA VIDA (IRE)
  3. ROCK ON SUZIE (IRE)

races.name: Matchbook Betting Exchange Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
An ultra-competitive finale in which the vote goes to TUDORISTA, who is yet to get her head in front but Edward Power's mare is well and truly knocking on the door in recent weeks. Head For Home confirmed his return to form in a change of headgear at Down Royal 10 days ago so he rates as a threat, with Le Fanu, Westin Pimpernel and Mellem a handful of others worth considering, as well.

  1. TUDORISTA (IRE)
  2. HEAD FOR HOME (IRE)
  3. LE FANU (IRE)

races.name: President Michel Bodiguel de Loire-Atlantique Chase
Chateau des ducs de Bretagne Handicap
Grand Prix de l'Hippodrome du Bouscat - Attele
